sits low in the frame, its body catching faint reflections as it moves forward. It begins in deep shadow near the center of the lane, headlights pushing two pale cones into the dark ahead. As it pulls forward out of the dark, light from an unseen opening grows across the road, first glazing the surface, then revealing the wall texture and lane lines. The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed, keeping the car's proportions steady while the tunnel slips past on either side. The movement is continuous and measured:

rolls forward, crosses from shadow into the illuminated pool, and continues down the tunnel. Its tires stay within the lane; its headlights sweep across the wall as the road curves slightly. The lighting shifts from near-black around the edges of the frame to a cool, diffuse glow on the hood, roof, and side panels, with brighter highlights where the opening reflects on the paint.
